name: iobroker.sharegy
description: Official Sharegy Adapter: EMS Energy Management, Floor Heating Thermal Battery Dispatch, Telemetry & Bidirectional Smart Load Control

scripts.check-version: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'), io=require('./io-package.json'); if(p.version !== io.common.version) { console.error('Version mismatch: package.json ('+p.version+') !== io-package.json ('+io.common.version+')'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Version match OK: ' + p.version);"
